definition.en: What a piece of land is used for: homes, farms, factories, roads or green space. A Master Plan shows planned use.
definition.zh: 【待译】What a piece of land is used for: homes, farms, factories, roads or green space. A Master Plan shows planned use.

definition.en: A legal land-use plan prepared by the Urban Redevelopment Authority. It shows permitted uses and building density and is reviewed every five years.
definition.zh: 【待译】A legal land-use plan prepared by the Urban Redevelopment Authority. It shows permitted uses and building density and is reviewed every five years.

definition.en: The Malay word for village. Singapore kampongs included clusters of timber houses; services and living conditions varied from place to place.
definition.zh: 【待译】The Malay word for village. Singapore kampongs included clusters of timber houses; services and living conditions varied from place to place.

definition.en: A timber house roofed with palm leaves. Raised floors help air circulate and keep the house above wet ground.
definition.zh: 【待译】A timber house roofed with palm leaves. Raised floors help air circulate and keep the house above wet ground.

definition.en: A public housing apartment built by the Housing and Development Board. Flats sold by HDB generally have a 99-year lease.
definition.zh: 【待译】A public housing apartment built by the Housing and Development Board. Flats sold by HDB generally have a 99-year lease.

definition.en: A housing town planned with a centre, schools, shops, clinics and transport, as well as homes.
definition.zh: 【待译】A housing town planned with a centre, schools, shops, clinics and transport, as well as homes.

definition.en: Moving residents or businesses to another place when land is needed for a new use. Compensation or housing assistance follows the rules in force at the time.
definition.zh: 【待译】Moving residents or businesses to another place when land is needed for a new use. Compensation or housing assistance follows the rules in force at the time.

definition.en: The government taking private land under a law for public purposes, with compensation. Owners can dispute an award through the legal process.
definition.zh: 【待译】The government taking private land under a law for public purposes, with compensation. Owners can dispute an award through the legal process.

definition.en: Making new land by enclosing shallow sea and filling it with sand or other material.
definition.zh: 【待译】Making new land by enclosing shallow sea and filling it with sand or other material.

definition.en: Land set aside and leased to farms using technology to produce crops, animals or fish.
definition.zh: 【待译】Land set aside and leased to farms using technology to produce crops, animals or fish.

definition.en: Growing plants without soil, with their roots supplied by water containing nutrients.
definition.zh: 【待译】Growing plants without soil, with their roots supplied by water containing nutrients.

definition.en: An area planned for factories and related businesses, with shared roads, water and electricity.
definition.zh: 【待译】An area planned for factories and related businesses, with shared roads, water and electricity.

definition.en: A place protected by law for its natural habitats, plants and animals. Development and activities are restricted.
definition.zh: 【待译】A place protected by law for its natural habitats, plants and animals. Development and activities are restricted.

definition.en: Land where the rain that falls is collected and led by streams, drains and canals into the same reservoir.
definition.zh: 一片土地上落下的雨水，经溪流、水沟和运河被引进同一个蓄水池，这片土地就是那个蓄水池的集水区。
